CWE-78.explanation: OS Command Injection occurs when untrusted input reaches system-level commands.
CWE-78.fix: Use parameterized commands, avoid shell=True, sanitize input with shlex.quote.

CWE-95.explanation: Eval injection happens when dynamic code execution is allowed.
CWE-95.fix: Avoid eval(), use safe parsing functions, validate input.

CWE-79.explanation: Cross-site scripting happens when user-controlled HTML or JS is served unescaped.
CWE-79.fix: Use proper HTML escaping, Content Security Policy, avoid innerHTML.
